convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: I wanted to talk to you about this Royal Accord. Would you be willing to support it?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Royal Accord? Hmm...

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: No I don't think so.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Why not?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Why not what?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Why can't you support the new Royal Accord?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Ah yes, the new Royal Accord. Well Councillor Unkar has been a good dwarf his whole life. He can't be involved in any of this.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: I know it's hard to hear, but I think he is.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: No, no, no. That's not right at all. You must be getting confused somewhere. Councillor Andrews is the problem.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Oh, I know! We can replace Councillor Andrews with Councillor Unkar. What an excellent idea! This calls for a sherry.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Lady Lovakengj please, you have to believe me! Councillor Unkar isn't innocent in this.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Well you can't go believing Councillor Orson! He's clearly just jealous of Councillor Unkar's success.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Okay, well how about I find some proof that Councillor Unkar is involved? Then will you support the Royal Accord?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Oh... well I suppose so, but I don't think you'll find any. Councillor Unkar is innocent.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Right. Let me chat to Commander Fullore about this.
Hello Lady Lovakengj.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: I'm still looking into things with Councillor Unkar. I'll let you know once I find something.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Okay human. I'm sure you'll soon see that Councillor Unkar is innocent.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Hello there.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: What do you want?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: We need to talk about this Royal Accord.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Don't waste your time. I will never sign that thing.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: So you'd see the corrupt Council stay in charge?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Of course not, you fool. Did you not listen earlier? The people should decide, not us.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Well it seems like there's a clear solution to this then.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: I doubt that.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: For the Royal Accord to be finalised, we can have the people vote on it. That way, they get the final say.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: It would still see us return to a single ruler.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Only if that's what people want. If they vote no, we come up with an alternative arrangement and let them vote on that instead.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Eugh.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Come on now. If you do care for the people, this is the best option.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Fine. It's still a stupid move, but if there's to be a vote, I might be willing to support it.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Might?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Yes. First, there's something else we need to discuss.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Of course there is.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: While you've been running around chasing dead princesses and mad mages, you've forgotten what started all of this. You summoned a demon in my home!

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: No... I killed a demon that someone else summoned in your home. You should thank me.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Really? Thank you for being as useless as I feared.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: How about we skip over the insults this time and you just tell me what you want.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: The Disciples of Yama are a big problem. They need dealing with.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Tell Lord Shayzien to send the army in, then. They literally live right on his doorstep.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Exactly! They live on his doorstep and he cares more about stupid lizardmen. The man is clearly as incompetent as you.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Thanks. So it sounds like you want me to take on this cult singlehandedly? I feel like that won't go well.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Of course I don't expect you to take on an entire cult! What you need to do is cut the head off the snake. Remove the influence of their leader and they won't be a problem.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: So, what? Kill Yama?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: No. Yama has no presence among his followers. At least, not yet. If you remove their connection to him, he won't be able to communicate with them.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: I know of a mage in Arceuus who's hopefully not as useless as you or Lord Shayzien. Her name is Mori and she's been investigating the Disciples of Yama. She should be able to help.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Woah! Slow down there. How do you know all of this?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Because I did some digging. Oddly enough I wasn't going to ignore a corrupt councillor summoning a demon on my docks.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: You learnt all of this just with a bit of digging? There's something you're not telling me here. Besides, why would you care so much about this compared to everything else going on?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: This conversation is pointless. If you want my support, this is the price. Now go and talk to Mori. I hear she spends most of her time in the Arceuus Church.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Fine. I'll be back later.
Hello there.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: Have you spoken to Mori yet?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.player: Not yet.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-la.text: From what I hear, she spends most of her time in the Arceuus Church. Now clear off.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Ah, there you are citizen. There's something I need to discuss with you.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: The Royal Accord?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Correct, citizen. Once the Council are removed from power, we will need a new ruler. I for one think this Royal Accord is the perfect move.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: I think we can also agree that when the times comes, I will be a suitable candidate to rule. These are unstable times. My military leadership will put me in a good position to take over.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Do you think the other leaders will support that?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: I've no doubt they'll consider me a strong contender. That said, I expect Lord Hosidius will also be considered. On that note, there's a job I have that would be perfect for one with your skills.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: What is it?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Before we come to finalise this Royal Accord, we need to be sure that everyone is in a place where they can pick the right ruler.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: While Lord Hosidius seems like a good man for the job, I've recently obtained some intelligence that could suggest otherwise. I'd like you to look into this.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Lord Hosidius? Interesting... What is this intelligence?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Some of my best people have been looking into the disappearance of Phileas Rimor and King Shayzien VII's journal. We now believe we have located both.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Hang on... Phileas Rimor?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: That's right. Is there a problem, citizen?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Well... no. Sorry, carry on.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Very well... I will personally see to the rescue of Phileas. I need you to recover the journal.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Hang on... I thought this was about Lord Hosidius?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: That it is, citizen. If our intelligence is to be believed, Lord Hosidius is now in possession of the journal.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: That doesn't make sense! Why would Lord Hosidius want that journal?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: That I don't know, citizen. Lord Hosidius is meant to be an ally to Shayzien. After all, he's married to my sister.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Perhaps this is some plot of his to grow his influence. He may wish to use the journal to discredit my family. Regardless, I need you to retrieve it. Only then will we be able to determine the truth.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: This is all very odd. Do you know where he keeps the journal?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Apparently he has a private office hidden below the Hosidius Vinery. That will likely be where he's keeping it. You'll need to go there, find out how to enter this office and then recover the journal.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Okay. I'll let you know what I find.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: Hello there citizen. Have you found that journal?

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Not yet.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.text: It's critical that you do so, as soon as possible. It will likely be in Lord Hosidius' hidden office below the Hosidius Vinery.

convincing-the-five-houses-talking-to-lo.player: Okay. I'll let you know what I find.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: How do you know that?

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: It is our place to know.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: I was hoping you could take a look at this device and tell me more about the person that made it.
Why what?
Because this device is the thing that was redirecting power from the Dark Altar. The person who made it was also responsible for the trapped soul that needed freeing.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: And so we shall help you.
You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal magically inspect the device.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Two others?
Darkness? That sounds like Xamphur. Can you tell how old he is?

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: His body was born long ago.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: In the time of the great betrayer.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Great betrayer? Do you mean Xeric?
You know of him?
But is that who you speak of?
So Lord Arceuus was right. What of this other person, the one touched by fire?
A Pyromancer? Xamphur is working with a Pyromancer?
Hang on... I recently helped to repair some damage to the Doors of Dinh. What if this Pyromancer was the one responsible?
Well then what's to stop them doing it again? We have to do something!

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: We have no part in this.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Keeping the balance between life and death. That's your thing isn't it? If the Wintertodt escapes, it will destroy all life in Kourend. That doesn't seem very balanced!

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: The human makes a valid point.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Well it's been known to happen.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: The Dark Altar powers the Doors of Dinh.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: How?

options.text: Where can I get volcanic sulphur?

steps.player: Where can I get volcanic sulphur?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: It can be mined in Lovakengj.

steps.player: Got it. I'll be back soon.

options.text: Sulphur in a defence potion. Got it. I'll be back soon.

steps.player: Sulphur in a defence potion. Got it. I'll be back soon.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

options.text: Where can I get volcanic sulphur?
Alright. I'll be back soon.

steps.player: Alright. I'll be back soon.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: I have the potion.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal enchant the potion.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: Pour it on the Doors of Dinh.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: And your work will be done.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Alright. I'll get it sorted.
What am I meant to be doing again?

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: Pour it on the Doors of Dinh.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: And your work will be done.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Alright. I'll get it sorted.
I lost the potion.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: We prepared for such an outcome.
You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal replace your potion.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: Pour it on the Doors of Dinh.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.text: And your work will be done.

lord-arceuus-favour-speaking-to-the-tasa.player: Okay. I'll get it sorted.

lord-arceuus-favour-pouring-the-shieldin.player: Well that's that done. I'd better get back to Lord Arceuus.

lord-arceuus-favour-pouring-the-shieldin.speaker: Ignisia
lord-arceuus-favour-pouring-the-shieldin.text: Hey! What are you doing with those doors?

lord-arceuus-favour-pouring-the-shieldin.speaker: Ignisia
lord-arceuus-favour-pouring-the-shieldin.text: Well you can either go through them or leave them alone.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: Hello there. Have you spoken with the Tasakaal?

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: I have. They confirmed that this Xamphur is the same one that served Xeric.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: So it's as I feared. This is not good.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: There's more. We discovered that Xamphur has been working with a Pyromancer. That means he may have been involved in the sabotage of the Doors of Dinh.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: A Pyromancer? Do you know who?

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: Are you sure about this? Had the Doors of Dinh fully failed, the Wintertodt would have destroyed Kourend. What would Xamphur gain from that?

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: I don't know, but the Tasakaal themselves confirmed it.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: I will have someone look into this. We'll also use this new knowledge to try and locate Xamphur.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: His master said they'd meet again in the south.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: Interesting. This is useful information that could help our search. I wonder... could they mean the southern Kingdom of Varlamore?

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: Ah, but that's one for another time. I believe we've learnt all we can about Xamphur for now. Until we can locate him, we must turn our focus towards the Council.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: So you'll support the new Royal Accord?

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: I will. While I have no desire to rule myself, I'll gladly support one of my fellow leaders in that role.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.player: Thank you. I'd better go and speak with the others.

lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
lord-arceuus-favour-talking-to-lord-arce.text: Hello there. You have my support with the Royal Accord. You should speak with the others.

lord-hosidius-favour-the-barbarian-camp.speaker: Barbarian Warlord
lord-hosidius-favour-the-barbarian-camp.text: You shouldn't be here! Time to die!

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: You came for me! I knew you would!

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.player: I don't understand Phileas. Why are you here?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: These barbarians raided my home! They took me prisoner. I thought they were going to kill me!

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: I don't know. I heard one of them saying they'd been paid to do it. But who would pay to have me captured?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.player: Wait! What about that parcel? The one with King Shayzien VII's journal. Do you have it?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: No. They took it from me. You don't think that's what this was about, do you?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.player: I'm not sure, but I don't like this at all. I need to speak with Lord Hosidius.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: Lord Hosidius? What's he got to do with this? And what about me?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.player: There's too much to explain right now. Now, there are a lot of barbarians outside, so I can't free you at the moment. I'll go get help. Don't worry, you'll be safe soon.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: Alright. But please, don't take long.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: Is it safe to free me yet?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.player: Not yet. I need to go and speak to Lord Hosidius. Don't worry, you'll be safe soon.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.speaker: Phileas Rimor
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-phileas-.text: Alright. But please, don't take long.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Hello there. Any luck with that barbarian camp?

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.player: We need to get some people down there urgently! The barbarians have Phileas Rimor prisoner.
He's a retired soldier from Shayzien. I helped him out with something a while ago, but he went missing. Turns out these barbarians were paid to take him.
I don't know for sure, but I doubt Lord Shayzien's visit was a coincidence.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: So, it's as I feared. Still, that doesn't explain why Lord Shayzien would pay for one of his own citizens to be captured.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.player: The thing I was helping Phileas with involved a mysterious parcel he'd received. The parcel contained King Shayzien VII's journal. When Phileas was captured, it was taken by the barbarians.
Before that happened, I followed some clues in the journal. They eventually led me to the discovery that King Shayzien VII may have been responsible for the creation of the lizardmen.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Ah, the discovery at Quidamortem. This is all starting to make sense. It's long been believed that King Shayzien VII eventually became Xeric. That discovery did little to suggest otherwise.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Lord Shayzien wouldn't have been too happy of further evidence that Xeric was part of his family. He must have made arrangements to hide as much of that evidence as possible.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Thank you, friend. I think we have all the information we need. I'll have some of my people head to this camp. They'll ensure Phileas is safe.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It's probably best he disappear for a while, for his own safety. I'll make the arrangements.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: For now, nothing. We should keep this information to ourselves, until the time is right. As for the Royal Accord, I am ready to finalise things when you are.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.player: Okay. I guess I'd better go and speak with the others.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Hello there. Thank you for your help earlier. You'll be pleased to know that Phileas is now safe.

lord-hosidius-favour-talking-to-lord-hos.player: That's good to hear. Thank you for taking care of him. I'd better go and speak with the others.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-comma.speaker: Commander Fullore
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-comma.text: Keep at it. We need to find a solution that they all agree on.

options.text: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

steps.player: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: What do you need?

steps.player: She doesn't believe that Councillor Unkar has anything to do with this. She wants proof he's involved before she signs the new Royal Accord.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: That's not too suprising. The two of them are old friends. I've got nothing on him, but I can think of one person who might be able to help.

steps.player: Martin?

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Exactly. His group has no doubt kept tabs on all of the councillors.

steps.player: But he's been arrested. I can't just go and break him out.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: No, but you can still talk to him. You've helped the Council enough that no one would think much of it if you paid him a visit.

steps.player: Fair point, I suppose. If anyone asks, I can claim I'm trying to round up more of his group.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Nice idea. They took him to the Shayzien Prison, just west of the city.

steps.player: Alright. I'll go and see what he knows.

options.text: I wanted to ask you something about the leaders.

steps.player: I wanted to ask you something about the leaders.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Go ahead.

options.text: I'd better get going.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-comma.speaker: Commander Fullore
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-comma.text: Keep at it. We need to find a solution that they all agree on.

options.text: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

steps.player: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Have you spoken to Martin? He's in the Shayzien Prison, just west of the city.

steps.player: I'll go and see what he knows.

options.text: I wanted to ask you something about the leaders.
I'd better get going.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Guard
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Sorry, but I can't let you talk to the prisoners.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: But I'm here on Council business. I need to learn more about his group.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Guard
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Ah yes! You're the one that helped with Councillor Hughes. Carry on then.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Oh wonderful! There's free food and a bed! Can you believe it? Luxury compared to anything in Port Piscarilius!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Well I'm glad you're keeping your spirits up. Now, I need your help with something.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Of course. Right down to business. As you can see, I'm a little indisposed right now. Apparently the right to protest isn't so much of a right after all.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Don't worry, it's just information I need. Things have progressed with the Council. I can't say any more here, but we're close. However, I need information on Councillor Unkar.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Excellent work my friend! From the moment I met you, I knew you were something special. Now, what information do you need on him?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Anything that could prove his corruption.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: If I had information on his corruption, I might not be stood in a cell right now.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Of course, but you must have something on him. Anything could be helpful at this point.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: I see. Well, there's a member of the Royal Society who has close access to Councillor Unkar's dealings. He gives me regular reports, but there hasn't been anything of note yet.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Still, things have progressed fast recently. Maybe he's had more luck since my imprisonment. As I'm stuck in here, perhaps you should go on my behalf to our usual meeting.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Sounds like a plan. Where does this meeting take place?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: In the Shayzien Graveyard of Heroes. Look for a dwarf. He'll speak with you if you say the passphrase: 'Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.'

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Thanks for the help, Martin. We'll have you out of there soon.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Good luck friend. Finish this for all of us!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: Hello again, Martin. Remind me, where is this meeting?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: In the Shayzien Graveyard of Heroes. Look for a dwarf. He'll speak with you if you say the passphrase: 'Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.'

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.player: That was it. Thanks for the help.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.speaker: Martin Holt
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-marti.text: Not a problem. Now get out there and finish this!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.player: I know you! You're Jorra, Lady Lovakengj's assistant.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: That's right. What brings you here, human?

options.text: The evening owl doesn't eat much pudding.

steps.player: The evening owl doesn't eat much pudding.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: What?

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Maybe you should go and lie down.

options.text: Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.

steps.player: Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Never have truer words been spoken. Martin sent you, right? I wasn't sure if anyone would come after he got arrested.

steps.player: That's right. So you're with the Royal Society? How come?

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Why wouldn't I be? The Council are nothing but trouble.

steps.player: But things don't seem too bad in Lovakengj with them in charge.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Lady Lovakengj is in charge of Lovakengj, not the Council. Sure, Councillor Unkar might act like he plays a big part, but it's all empty words.

steps.player: Do you not get sick of her asking for sherry?

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Not really. It's not like it's a hard job. Councillor Unkar would see us all work to death in the mines instead.

steps.player: I see. Well Councillor Unkar is why I'm here. I'm hoping you can give me something of note on him.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Any other day you'd be wasting your time, but today you're in luck. Due to the protests, Councillor Unkar has been staying at the castle for safety. I've had a chance to go through his private documents.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: I think you'll find...

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Wait! What was that?

steps.player: Oh no. Not again!

steps.speaker: Assassin
steps.text: Jorra Ashtar. You have been marked for death.

options.text: If tomorrow never comes, what is today?

steps.player: If tomorrow never comes, what is today?

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: What?

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Maybe you should go and lie down.

options.text: Nothing.

steps.player: Nothing.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Huh... Fair enough.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: That was close! Are you okay human?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: Martin warned me this would happen. The Council are trying to silence us!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: It's not safe for me here. I need to get back to Lovakengj. Here, this should hopefully give you what you need.
Jorra gives you a declaration from the Kourend Council.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.speaker: Jorra
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-jorra.text: You have what you need human. Now I need to get back to Lovakengj.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I have a declaration from the Council that I think you should see.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: You show the declaration to Lady Lovakengj.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: The Council wanted to remove me from power? They can't do that! It's not their right!

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I'm sorry. Do you now see why we need to stop them?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Yes... I understand. I will support this Royal Accord.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: And do you wish to be considered for the throne?

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh... No. Leave that for someone else.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Very well. Thank you Lady Lovakengj. I'd better go and speak with the others.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Oh, it's the human. Hello human.

lady-lovakengj-s-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Is there anything else I can do for you?
Fair enough. I'll go speak with the others.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Hello again. Thank you for everything you did for Thana. You are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: It's not a problem. Anyway, there was something I was hoping you could help me with.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Of course. What do you need?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: I have a situation with the Disciples of Yama. I hear you've been looking into them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Well... Yes, I have, but that research was meant to be a secret...

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Ah well, you're trustworthy I suppose. What can I help you with?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: What do you know of their leader, Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: He's a bit of a mystery. He's a demon of some sorts, but he doesn't seem to have any actual presence in Kourend yet. In fact, until recently, he had no connection to the cult.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: The Disciples of Yama once had no connection to Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: It does sound odd, but back then they were known as the Disciples of Chaos. They were just a small Zamorakian cult of little note.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Interesting. So if Yama has no presence among his followers, how does he communicate with them?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: Through another demon called the Voice of Yama.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: So if I killed this Voice of Yama, the cultists would lose their connection to Yama?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: For a time, though I imagine the Voice of Yama would be quickly replaced. However, if you wanted to remove that connection, I do have another idea...

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: After what happened with Thana, I volunteered to help out with the Dark Altar investigations. The device used there was redirecting power from the Altar, but a similar device could block a magical connection entirely.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Ah, I see. So we could use a device like that to block the connection between the Voice of Yama and Yama himself?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: That's right. We never tried it before because the Dark Altar issues were more pressing, but I don't see why it wouldn't work.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.player: Alright. So where can I get one of these devices?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: I should be able to make you one. I'll need some molten glass and a dark essence block.
If the player already has the required materials:

steps.player: I have those right here.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Huh... Fair enough.
You give Mori some molten glass and a dark essence block.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Right. You'll need to hide this somewhere in the Chasm of Fire. Here you go.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

steps.player: Alright. Thanks Mori.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori.text: If the player doesn't have the required materials:

steps.player: Where can I get a dark essence block?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: You can mine dense essence blocks from the mine north east of here. They can be turned into dark essence blocks using the Dark Altar.

steps.player: Okay, I'll come back once I have what you need.
I can get those for you. I'll come back once I have them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello again. Do you have some molten glass and a dark essence block yet?

options.text: Where can I get a dark essence block?
Not yet. I'll come back once I have them.

steps.player: Not yet. I'll come back once I have them.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello again. Do you have some molten glass and a dark essence block yet?
You give Mori some molten glass and a dark essence block.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: Right. You'll need to hide this somewhere in the Chasm of Fire. Here you go.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.player: Hello Mori. What should I be doing with this device?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: You just need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.player: Hello Mori. Do you think you could make me another one of those devices?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-mori-.text: I have enough supplies for another. Here, you'll need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.
Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: Ah, there you are. Our master foresaw your arrival.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: And you have the device as well. How wonderful.
You suddenly find yourself feeling very tired.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.speaker: Disciple of Yama
lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.text: Oh look at you. You need a good rest. Here, have a lie down.
You wake up in the forest.

lady-piscarilius-favour-entering-the-cha.player: Well that's the device hidden. Those Disciples of Yama won't be a problem anymore. I'd better tell Lady Piscarilius.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Have you dealt with the Disciples of Yama yet?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Absolutely. They won't be a problem anymore.
So will you now support this Royal Accord?

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Yes, but it's still a stupid idea. And don't even think about trying to put me in charge or something. I'll have no more part in this.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: I don't think you need to worry about that. Now, I'd better go and speak with the others.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.text: Good. I've had enough of talking with you.

lady-piscarilius-favour-talking-to-lady-.player: Fine. I need to speak with the others anyway.

options.text: Who are you?
I hear your father has an office here.

steps.player: I hear your father has an office here.

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: Office? What office?

steps.player: A secret one, I'm guessing?

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: There can't be any secret offices here. I'd have noticed. I notice lots of things, you know.

steps.player: Well in that case, have you noticed your father doing anything interesting here in the past?

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: He sometimes comes to inspect the wine barrels. I like to inspect them myself sometimes.

steps.player: More than inspect, by the looks of things. Thanks for the help.

steps.speaker: Pandur Hosidius
steps.text: You're welcome.

options.text: What are these farming patches for?
Have you been drinking?
I'll leave you to it.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Hello there, citizen. Have you found that journal?
You show the journal to Lord Shayzien.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Not to worry, I should be able to take care of that. When the time comes to finalise the Royal Accord, I will have the information we need to decide upon a new ruler.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.player: Alright. Thank you, Lord Shayzien. I should speak to Commander Fullore.

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.text: Hello there, citizen. Thank you for your help earlier. I am ready to support this Royal Accord!

lord-shayzien-s-favour-talking-to-lord-s.player: Alright. I'll go and talk with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Come with me. There's something you need to see.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Just come.
A cutscene plays. Commander Fullore and the player discover Councillor Orson has died outside Xeric's Lookout.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Yup.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I've no idea.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: You don't think he was pushed, do you?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I don't think so.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What can we do? Even Lord Arceuus can't bring back the dead. He's gone, and that's that.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Why did any of this have to happen?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: We can't undo what's been done, but we can still put an end to all this.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Does that mean you have good news?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Kind of. I think I've managed to convince all the leaders to sign the Accord. That said, I have no idea who they'll pick to rule.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well, we'll just have to make it work somehow. Maybe then we can finally end this nightmare.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I'll deal with this mess. Once I'm done, let's gather everyone downstairs again.
The scene transitions to the basement, where the leaders of the five Houses, bar Hosidius and Shayzien, appear.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Shall we get on with this then?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Not yet. Where's Lord Hosidius and Lord Shayzien?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius requested a private word with Lord Shayzien outside. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: In fact, I think I hear them now.
Lord Hosidius and Shayzien arrive to the meeting.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Now that everyone is here, I think we can begin.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What of the Councillor? Is he not joining us?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Councillor Orson is dead.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Dead? What happened?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Jumped from the top of the tower, probably. It doesn't matter, the world won't miss him. Let's move on.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Not the attitude I'd take, but it's true that we can't dwell on this. We need to focus on stopping Councillor Andrews.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Between the five of us, we can remove the Council from power with little violence. But what then? Are we willing to support a new Royal Accord?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Arceuus, let's start with you. What will it take for a new Royal Accord to gain your support?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: My position is a unique one. As such, I feel it would be inappropriate for me to involve myself too heavily in this. That said, I will gladly support the decision made by this group.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: You would not wish to rule yourself?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I will gladly advise the next ruler in any way I can, but it should not be me who takes the throne. I would recommend you look to Lord Hosidius or Lord Shayzien for that.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Very well. Lady Piscarilius?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: For the record, I think this is all a bad idea. Still, you're all clearly set on it, so I won't try and stop you.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: However, I stand by what I said before. The people should have a say. Anything we decide here should not be finalised until the people have voted on it.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Any thoughts from anyone?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I would be happy to see the people have a say.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: It could be a risky move.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: And? Without it, I'm not signing your precious document. If I don't sign, you get nothing.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Hmm. Very well.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Assuming the people agree to the new Accord, who do you think should rule the kingdom?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well not me, that's for sure. I can't imagine anything worse. Get one of these fools to do it.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lady Lovakengj?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Huh? Me?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Yes. What do you think?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... This is all quite something. I suppose the Council have to go though, don't they?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Would you be willing to take over?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Oh... No, I don't think so. I think I'll have a sherry instead.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Shayzien. What are your thoughts?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... I think the Royal Accord of Twill is a good starting point, but we'll need to make some changes for it to work.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lady Piscarilius wants the support of the people. Right now, they cry for a king. That means whoever takes the throne should take on the title of king or queen.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I also feel the act of transferring rulership from one house to the next - as in the original Accord - isn't going to work for us. What we need is consistency.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Would you be open to taking on the role yourself?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Err... No, I don't think that would be wise.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Are you sure? You seem to be a perfect candidate.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I don't feel I would be best placed for it. It would be better if I kept my focus on the important task of protecting Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I suggest we make Lord Hosidius the new ruler of Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: What the...

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Thank you, Lord Shayzien. Taking the throne is not a duty to be considered lightly, but I believe my family and I have what it takes to shoulder this responsibility.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: This decision will forever change the future of Kourend. If we go forward with this, the Hosidius family will be the new royal family of Kourend.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Shauna Piscarilius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well... This isn't quite what I expected, but sure. Let the idiot have his throne. As long as the people agree.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: He can do it, I suppose.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Lord Hosidius would be a fitting choice for the role, assuming no one else here is willing.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Are you sure about this Lord Shayzien?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I... I am.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: Then it sounds like we have an agreement.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: My friends, thank you for putting your trust in me. This kingdom has suffered through much of late, but now it is time for that suffering to end.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: In honour of her sacrifice, I name this declaration Rose's Accord. With it, the Kingdom of Great Kourend will no longer be a kingdom divided.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: I promise not to let you down.
The cutscene ends.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: So... What just happened there?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: It seems we might have a new king.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: But Lord Shayzien? He seemed like a perfect candidate, but he didn't even want to be considered. What happened?

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: I think I might have some idea, but I'm still a bit confused to be honest.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.text: Well, Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. Perhaps he can shed some light on all of this. He's downstairs.

the-new-royal-accord-rose-s-accord.player: I'll go and speak to him.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Hello there. No doubt you have questions about what just occurred.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I'm sorry for keeping you in the dark, my friend. It wasn't anything against you. I just couldn't afford to take any risks.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You planned this all along, didn't you? That's why you kept the Royal Accord of Twill.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It was inevitable that one day the Council would fall. Their rule has always been fragile.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: So you made sure that you'd be the one to replace them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It gives me no pleasure, but this was needed for the safety of all of Kourend. Apart from Lord Shayzien, the other rulers had no interest in the throne. It was always going to be him or me.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: And you didn't want it to be him?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: It was for the safety of Kourend. Lord Shayzien has a good military mind, but he is no ruler. After all, you saw what he did with Phileas.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: To Lord Shayzien, family name is everything. Above all else, he craves glory for himself and his house. Under him, war would have been inevitable.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Varlamore, the kingdom to the south. Our two kingdoms were in conflict less than a hundred years ago, and relations remain sour. It would take very little for that conflict to be reignited.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You really think Lord Shayzien would have declared war?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I can't say for sure, but it was a risk I did not intend to take.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: I see. So how did you do it?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: A while ago, I managed to acquire the old journal of King Shayzien VII. I knew that I could use it to discredit Lord Shayzien and his family, so I made some arrangements.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: Phileas' mystery parcel! That was you? You acted like you didn't even know him earlier!

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Apologies for the misdirection. It was indeed me who sent that parcel.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Had I revealed the contents of the journal myself, I would likely have just been dismissed as trying to create a rift between our two houses. Phileas was the perfect third party.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: But then Lord Shayzien had Phileas captured before he could reveal too much. This is all starting to make sense. You know, he actually blamed you for that!

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Phileas' disappearance was an interesting twist. I hadn't expected something like that. Still, it actually made things even easier in the end. Once Phileas was safe, I told Lord Shayzien and gave him a choice.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: Oh I see. You let him pick between supporting you or being exposed.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Exactly. The truth about Phileas would have lost him the support of his people and ruined his reputation.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: So in the end, you never actually needed to discredit him at all. What about the journal? Lord Shayzien sent me to steal it from you, but surely he already had it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I didn't want to risk losing the real journal. The one I sent to Phileas was a copy, with many bits removed. While I covered my tracks well, Lord Shayzien must have worked out I was involved.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: And he sent me to recover the real journal.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Yes. Unfortunately for him, the one you stole was a fake. The real one is somewhere much safer.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: You really thought of everything didn't you? How about the Accord? That was essential to your plans. I'm guessing it was no accident that Artur found it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: I can't take too much credit from Artur there. He did do most of the work himself. I'd been looking into the Accord for a while when Artur found my research.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: When he went missing, I feared the worst. It was a nice surprise when you not only brought him back, but the Accord as well.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.player: This is a lot to take in. I don't know if I like any of it.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Nor do I like it myself. However, when it comes to politics, there are no perfect options. Instead, all we can do is pick the best option we have.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: Anyway, we will have plenty of time to discuss this later. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-hos.text: We will have to talk more later my friend. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.text: Hello there. It's time for us to deal with the Council. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.player: Will do. I just need to talk to Lord Hosidius first.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-arc.text: Hello there. It's time for us to deal with the Council. You should speak with Commander Fullore.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.player: What happened there? Why didn't you put yourself forward to become king?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lord-sha.text: Well... It was a complex choice, citizen. I wouldn't worry about it. We're all ready to deal with the Council. Let's focus on that.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.text: Oh, it's the human. Shouldn't you be speaking with Commander Fullore?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.player: Actually I need to go talk to Lord Hosidius.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-lov.text: Oh, it's the human. Shouldn't you be speaking with Commander Fullore?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-lady-pis.player: Fine. I need to speak with Lord Hosidius anyway.
Fine. I need to speak with Commander Fullore anyway.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. He's downstairs.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: I'll go and speak to him.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: How did your chat with Lord Hosidius go?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: It was definitely illuminating. It seems there was only ever really one option for Kourend's new ruler.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: We'll have to talk about that later. It's time to pay a visit to the Council.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: We'll join the five leaders and head to the castle. There, we'll tell the councillors everything we know and present Rose's Accord to them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Do you think they'll come quietly?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: They won't have a choice. Lord Shayzien commands the Shayzien Army, and I command the Royal Guard. They'll have no one to protect them.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: They'll be imprisoned. It will be for the new ruler to decide their fates. As for that, we'll aim to hold the vote Lady Piscarilius requested as soon as possible.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: Assuming the people support Rose's Accord, we can have Lord Hosidius crowned within a few days.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Do you think they'll support it?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: I think so. Many are already calling out for a king, and Lord Hosidius is popular across the whole kingdom.

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.player: Sounds like we have everything covered, then. When do we depart?

the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-new-royal-accord-talking-to-commande.text: As soon as you're ready. From what I hear, the protest is getting close to breaking point. We can't waste any more time.

steps.text: Hold the line! Under no circumstances can this castle be breached!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: But Captain... They're citizens...

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Did you not hear me? Hold the line!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: That's right, hold the line! Show everyone who you really serve!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: We serve Great Kourend! You are all in violation of the laws of this kingdom!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Laws set by your false Council! If you really served Kourend, you wouldn't be here defending those monsters!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Step back citizen!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Or what? You'll kill me? Go on! I dare you to do it! See what happens!

steps.speaker: Protester
steps.text: Yeah! You can't kill us all!

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Stand back! I'm warning you!
Lord Shayzien, Lord Hosidius, Commander Fullore, and the player arrive at Kourend Castle.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Stand down, Captain Rachelle. This situation is now under my command.

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: Lord Shayzien? What's going on?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: These citizens are to be protected. Ensure they do not enter the castle, but do not allow any harm to come to them.

steps.speaker: Captain Rachelle
steps.text: As you wish, Lord Shayzien. It will be done.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Thank you, Captain. Now, myself and the other leaders will go and speak with the councillors. This situation will be resolved soon.
The scene transitions to the leaders of the five Houses meeting with Councillor Andrews.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Ah, Lord Shayzien. It's good to have you here. Hopefully with your support we can get this protest under control.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Though I must say, I'm a bit confused as to why everyone else is here. Is something happening?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: That would be one way to describe it Councillor. Lord Hosidius.

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: Councillor Andrews, Councillor Unkar. We are here to present a joint declaration from the five houses of Great Kourend.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Declaration? I don't understand.

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: We, the leaders of the five houses of Great Kourend, declare that the Kourend Council is no longer fit to rule. As such, you are relieved of your positions with immediate effect.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: What the... What is this?

steps.speaker: Lord Kandur Hosidius
steps.text: Furthermore, you will both hand yourselves over to Lord Shayzien's soldiers. They will take you into custody where you will await your trial.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Trial? Have you gone mad? Trial for what?

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: For the crimes of murder and high treason. Along with the now-deceased Liam Orson and Sophia Hughes, the two of you successfully conspired to murder King Kharedst IV and Crown Princess Rose.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Liam's... dead?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: This is insanity! Guards! Arrest them at once!

steps.speaker: Commander Fullore
steps.text: Soldiers of the Kourend Royal Guard, you serve the rightful ruler of Kourend! That is not this man. Stand down and step aside!
The royal guards leave.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: No! You can't do this!

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: David... It's over...

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Over? Only I decide when it's over! I am the rightful ruler of this kingdom and you all answer to me!

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Guards.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Stay away from me! This is my throne! I worked too hard for you to just take it away! I'd rather die!

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Do it.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: No!
The guards knock out Councillor Andrews.

steps.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.text: Take them away.
The cutscene ends.
