Attendees include the leaders of the five Houses bar Lord Shayzien, the Hosidius family, Martin Holt, Captain Ginea, Commander Fullore, Duke Horacio, Queen Ellamaria, King Roald, Sir Amik Varze, Sir Tiffy Cashien, King Lathas/Thoros, Queen Zyanyi Arkan, and her royal guards, the Kualti.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well, look who it is!

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Good to see you Martin.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Can you believe it? The coronation of a king! Truth be told, there were times I wondered if this day would ever come.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: And is it everything you hoped for?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Everything and more, my friend. And to think they even let us vote on it as well! Fantastic!

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Well the King certainly seems to have attracted plenty of guests.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Indeed. Seems that everyone wants to congratulate him... Or maybe they're just here for the food.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Either way, this will be an event for the ages.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Are all the leaders here as well?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Most of them. Lord Shayzien was here earlier but he left. To be honest, he didn't look to be enjoying himself.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's not too suprising. Things weren't exactly straightforward between him and the King when this was all arranged.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Yes, I heard there was a bit of drama here and there. Still, that's Kourend for you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Martin Holt
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, I'll let you go and mingle. I'm sure the King himself will want a word with you at some point as well.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Alright. Have fun Martin.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The player walks towards Lord Arceuus.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Hello Lord Arceuus.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Good to see you friend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Any word on Xamphur?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Nothing yet. However, we did manage to search his lair in Molch.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Find anything interesting?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Most of it had been cleared out before we arrived. There was some research left behind though. Notes on potential new spells.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Some are far too dangerous to use, but others we've found to be safe. We're preparing a tome of all the ones that are suitable. I'll make sure you get a copy once we're done.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's very kind of you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's the least we can do after all you have done for us. Anyway, I won't keep you. Enjoy the coronation.
The player walks towards Commander Fullore.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: There you are! I was worried you'd miss all the fun.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: No chance. It's not every day you crown a new king.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preperations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: You'd think security would be one of the hard parts, but I actually reckon our bit is pretty straightforward in comparison.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: On that note, how does it feel to be serving a king now?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I don't think it's quite sunk in yet. It still feels like it was only this morning that Councillor Hughes escaped. So much has happened in such a short time.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Tell me about it. Had I known how this would go when Martin first recruited me, I'd have probably considered running for the hills as fast as possible.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: It wouldn't have been possible without you or Martin either. Have you two spoken yet?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Oh, I'm going to need a lot to drink before I'm ready for that conversation.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Fair enough.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Anyway, have you seen our special guest?
The scene pans towards the front banquet table.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's a pleasure to finally welcome you to Great Kourend, Queen Zyanyi. You are very welcome here.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Who is she?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Zyanyi Arkan, the Sun Queen. She's the ruler of Varlamore, the kingdom in the south. This is her first visit to Kourend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: First visit?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Indeed. The King personally invited her. He's keen to put an end to the animosity between the two kingdoms. Rumor has it she feels the same way.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Who are the knights with her?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Her royal guard, the Kualti.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: They look fancy.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: They do. If the stories are true, they're the best fighters in Varlamore.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Not jealous are you?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Not of that armour, that's for sure. It looks very uncomfortable.
Queen Zyanyi Arkan and her Kualti begin to leave.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Ah, looks like they're done. You should go and see the King. He was pretty keen to speak to you.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Okay. I'll see you later.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The player approaches King Kandur Hosidius.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Good to see you, Your Majesty. Congratulations on your coronation.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Thank you my friend. Of course, none of this would have been possible without you. Let it be known that you will always be a friend of this kingdom.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Thank you, I'm very honoured.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Gather around honoured guests! It's time for me to bore you all with a speech!
The guests approach King Kandur Hosidius.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Friends, thank you all for joining me on this special day. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Kourend, and I could not be more grateful to have you all here to celebrate with me.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Still, let us not forget the hard road that led us here, nor those who were brave enough to walk along it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, [player name]. Without you, we would all still be living in ignorance. You opened our eyes to the truth, and ensured a strong future for Kourend.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, let us all raise our glasses to these three. We are forever in their debt.
The scene fades to black, and transitions to one with King Kandur Hosidius and the player alone behind Kourend's throne.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Ah, there you are.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: You wanted to speak to me?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I did. Sorry to take you away from the festivities. With everyone else celebrating, I thought it would be a good chance to talk in private. Don't worry. It won't take long.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: It's not a problem. What did you want to discuss?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: The councillors are behind bars and Kourend has a new ruler. On the surface, all is well again. Of course, that's not quite the case in reality.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: You mean Xamphur?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Yes. The Council did not act alone. In fact, they weren't even the true orchestrators in this. We need to find and deal with the real foe before it's too late.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: I'd be happy to help in any way I can. Xamphur and I have unfinished business.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I was hoping you'd say that. This is a serious threat we're facing, and I need people I can trust.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: So, what do you need me to do?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Nothing for now. I just wanted to make sure you were on board. Once we have more information on Xamphur, I will let you know.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, we should head back downstairs before we are missed.
A knife is launched at the king's back.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Is everything alright, Your Majesty?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: King Kandur Hosidius
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I... I can't...
The king falls, and an assassin is revealed to the player.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Assassin
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Kandur Hosidius. You have been marked for death.
The assassin teleports away, and the cutscene ends.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Hey Lydia. How are you doing?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: It's been a rough few days since the coronation, as you can probably imagine. One moment we were crowning a new king, that next we were burying him. I'm doing okay, though. Work is a good distraction.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: And how's that going?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Well Artur Hosidius is now the King of Great Kourend. I'm sorry you couldn't be there for the ceremony. After what happened, they felt something small would be best.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: That's fine. I think one coronation was enough for me. Any word on the killer?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: There's no shortage of potential suspects, but nothing solid. We've had the murder weapon sent over to Lovakengj to be examined. They have a theory, but want to do more work before they confirm it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Well let me know once they have something. I want to find whoever did this.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: We will.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.player: Anything else I can do in the meantime?

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: I don't think so. Lord Arceuus is trying to find out more about Xamphur, but he doesn't have anything yet. For now, all we can do is wait.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.

the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.speaker: Commander Fullore
the-council-s-end-coronation-ceremony.text: Now, I'll let you get going. Thanks again, for everything.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
